inventory.query: SELECT entity_type,count(*) AS flagged_records,count(*) FILTER(WHERE website IS NOT NULL AND website<>'') AS with_base_website,count(*) FILTER(WHERE profile?'website') AS raw_website_present,count(*) FILTER(WHERE owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR owner_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AS owned_records FROM zoi.listings WHERE publish_status='published' AND moderation_status IN('clean','cleared') AND coalesce(marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden' AND (profile#>>'{_enrich,blocked_reason}'='source_scope_mismatch' OR profile#>>'{_enrich,scope_review_required}'='true' OR profile#>>'{_enrich,organization_identity_quarantine}'='true') GROUP BY entity_type ORDER BY entity_type;

samples.query: SELECT id,name,city,website,profile#>>'{_enrich,source_url}' AS source_url,profile#>>'{_enrich,blocked_reason}' AS blocked_reason,profile#>>'{_enrich,scope_review_required}' AS review_required,profile#>>'{_enrich,organization_identity_quarantine}' AS identity_quarantine FROM zoi.listings WHERE publish_status='published' AND moderation_status IN('clean','cleared') AND coalesce(marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden' AND (profile#>>'{_enrich,blocked_reason}'='source_scope_mismatch' OR profile#>>'{_enrich,scope_review_required}'='true' OR profile#>>'{_enrich,organization_identity_quarantine}'='true') ORDER BY entity_type,id LIMIT 10;
